responses.text: {Bad person just walked in} Got some nerve, coming to an NCR outpost with that look about you. {Low, warning} Hope you aren't here to trade, not sure you can afford the prices.
{Mildly curious} New face in the Outpost, must've come from the North. {Frowns} So - what'll you have?
Back round? Just my luck... what'll it be this time? {Curious, then slight irritation, as if the player's putting her out by just being there.}
{Skeptical, player's bad news} For you? I'm not sure I want to be seen dealing with you... {changes tune} but if you're willing to pay a little extra...

topics.prompt: What do you have for trade?

responses.text: What, Caravan? All right, I'll give it a go. {Shrugs} Haven't exactly got much of a line of folks to serve.

topics.prompt: I was hoping to pass the time with a game or two.

responses.text: All right, go on - let's put our cards down.
{Shrugs} Not too much, lot of caravans going nowhere. {Beat} Lot of troopers going nowhere, too.
Few prospectors here and there, but... {shrug} they don't do more than stink up the place.
Everybody's backed up here. {Scoffs} You think it'd be good for business, but most of the traders are tight with the caps, even the larger caravan outfits.

topics.prompt: Anything you can tell me about the Outpost?

responses.text: {Dismissive} Work around here? Might check with Jackson in the main building. Or Ghost up on the roof above, but watch out, she's... well, she's kind of a bitch.
{Backpedals} Don't tell her I said that, though. {Beat, to herself} Might take a bullet some night when I'm going to the latrine.

topics.prompt: Never mind, I'll be going now.
